sternocleidomastoid.name: Sternocleidomastoid
sternocleidomastoid.origin: Sternal head: manubrium; Clavicular head: medial third of clavicle
sternocleidomastoid.action: Bilateral: cervical flexion; Unilateral: ipsilateral lateral flexion, contralateral rotation
sternocleidomastoid.innervation: Cranial nerve XI (spinal accessory nerve) with contributions from C2-C3
sternocleidomastoid.blood_supply: Superior thyroid artery, occipital artery, suprascapular artery

splenius-capitis.name: Splenius Capitis
splenius-capitis.description: Splenius Capitis (العضلة الطاحلة الرأسية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
splenius-capitis.origin: Lower half of nuchal ligament and spinous processes of C7-T3
splenius-capitis.insertion: Mastoid process and lateral superior nuchal line
splenius-capitis.action: Bilateral: cervical extension; Unilateral: ipsilateral rotation and lateral flexion
splenius-capitis.innervation: Dorsal rami of middle cervical spinal nerves (C3-C5)

splenius-cervicis.name: Splenius Cervicis
splenius-cervicis.description: Splenius Cervicis (العضلة الطاحلة العنقية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
splenius-cervicis.insertion: Posterior tubercles of C1-C3 transverse processes
splenius-cervicis.action: Bilateral: cervical extension; Unilateral: ipsilateral rotation and lateral flexion
splenius-cervicis.innervation: Dorsal rami of lower cervical spinal nerves (C5-C7)

scalenus-anterior.name: Scalenus Anterior
scalenus-anterior.description: Scalenus Anterior (العضلة الأخمصية الأمامية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
scalenus-anterior.origin: Anterior tubercles of transverse processes of C3-C6 vertebrae
scalenus-anterior.insertion: Scalene tubercle on superior surface of 1st rib
scalenus-anterior.action: Elevates 1st rib (inspiration); lateral flexion and rotation of cervical spine
scalenus-anterior.innervation: Anterior rami of cervical nerves C4-C6

scalenus-medius.name: Scalenus Medius
scalenus-medius.description: Scalenus Medius (العضلة الأخمصية المتوسطة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
scalenus-medius.origin: Posterior tubercles of transverse processes of C2-C7 vertebrae
scalenus-medius.insertion: Superior surface of 1st rib behind subclavian groove
scalenus-medius.action: Elevates 1st rib; lateral flexion of neck
scalenus-medius.innervation: Anterior rami of cervical nerves C3-C8
scalenus-medius.blood_supply: Ascending cervical artery and deep cervical artery

scalenus-posterior.name: Scalenus Posterior
scalenus-posterior.description: Scalenus Posterior (العضلة الأخمصية الخلفية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
scalenus-posterior.origin: Posterior tubercles of transverse processes of C4-C6 vertebrae
scalenus-posterior.action: Elevates 2nd rib; lateral flexion of cervical spine
scalenus-posterior.innervation: Anterior rami of cervical nerves C6-C8

longus-colli.name: Longus Colli
longus-colli.description: Longus Colli (العضلة العنقية الطويلة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
longus-colli.origin: Anterior tubercles of C3-C5, vertebral bodies C5-T3
longus-colli.insertion: Anterior arch of atlas (C1), bodies of C2-C4, transverse processes C5-C6
longus-colli.action: Flexion and lateral flexion of cervical spine, segmental cervical stabilization
longus-colli.innervation: Anterior rami of C2-C6 spinal nerves

longus-capitis.name: Longus Capitis
longus-capitis.description: Longus Capitis (العضلة الرأسية الطويلة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
longus-capitis.origin: Anterior tubercles of transverse processes of C3-C6 vertebrae
longus-capitis.action: Flexion of head and upper cervical spine
longus-capitis.innervation: Anterior rami of C1-C3 spinal nerves

rectus-capitis-anterior.name: Rectus Capitis Anterior
rectus-capitis-anterior.description: Rectus Capitis Anterior (العضلة الرأسية المستقيمة الأمامية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
rectus-capitis-anterior.origin: Anterior surface of lateral mass of atlas (C1)
rectus-capitis-anterior.insertion: Basilar part of occipital bone anterior to foramen magnum
rectus-capitis-anterior.innervation: Anterior rami of C1 and C2 spinal nerves

rectus-capitis-lateralis.name: Rectus Capitis Lateralis
rectus-capitis-lateralis.description: Rectus Capitis Lateralis (العضلة الرأسية المستقيمة الوحشية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
rectus-capitis-lateralis.origin: Superior surface of transverse process of atlas (C1)
rectus-capitis-lateralis.action: Lateral flexion of head to ipsilateral side
rectus-capitis-lateralis.innervation: Anterior rami of C1 and C2 spinal nerves

masseter.name: Masseter
masseter.origin: Zygomatic arch and maxillary process of zygomatic bone
masseter.action: Elevation and protraction of mandible (closes jaw)

temporalis.name: Temporalis
temporalis.origin: Temporal fossa and deep temporal fascia
temporalis.insertion: Coronoid process and anterior border of mandibular ramus

supraspinatus.name: Supraspinatus
supraspinatus.description: Supraspinatus (العضلة فوق الشوكة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
supraspinatus.action: Initiates abduction; biphasic function (horizontal extensor/internal rotator in anterior planes; horizontal flexor/external rotator in posterior planes)
supraspinatus.blood_supply: Suprascapular artery, acromial branch of thoracoacromial artery, anterior circumflex humeral artery

infraspinatus.name: Infraspinatus
infraspinatus.description: Infraspinatus (العضلة تحت الشوكة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
infraspinatus.action: External rotation, horizontal extension; arm elevation (particularly in posterior planes)
infraspinatus.blood_supply: Suprascapular artery, posterior circumflex humeral artery

teres-minor.name: Teres Minor
teres-minor.description: Teres Minor (العضلة المدورة الصغيرة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
teres-minor.action: External rotation, horizontal extension; antagonist to elevation

subscapularis.name: Subscapularis
subscapularis.description: Subscapularis (العضلة تحت الكتف) - Functional anatomical muscle.
subscapularis.action: Internal rotation, adduction; superior portion contributes to arm elevation and horizontal flexion; inferior portion primarily horizontal flexion and internal rotation
subscapularis.blood_supply: Subscapular artery, anterior circumflex humeral artery, posterior circumflex humeral artery

anterior-deltoid.name: Anterior Deltoid
anterior-deltoid.description: Anterior Deltoid (العضلة الدالية الأمامية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
anterior-deltoid.action: Arm elevation (particularly in anterior planes), horizontal flexion
anterior-deltoid.blood_supply: Thoracoacromial artery, anterior circumflex humeral artery

lateral-deltoid.name: Lateral Deltoid
lateral-deltoid.description: Lateral Deltoid (العضلة الدالية الجانبية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
lateral-deltoid.insertion: Deltoid tuberosity on lateral aspect of humerus
lateral-deltoid.action: Primary abductor of glenohumeral joint (from 15° to 90°)

posterior-deltoid.name: Posterior Deltoid
posterior-deltoid.description: Posterior Deltoid (العضلة الدالية الخلفية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
posterior-deltoid.action: Horizontal abduction, extension; antagonist to elevation in anterior arm positions
posterior-deltoid.innervation: Axillary nerve (anterior branch in 91.5% of cases, posterior branch in 8.5%)

pectoralis-major.name: Pectoralis Major
pectoralis-major.description: Pectoralis Major (العضلة الصدرية الكبرى) - Functional anatomical muscle.
pectoralis-major.origin: Clavicular head: medial half of clavicle; Sternal head: sternum and costal cartilages 1-6
pectoralis-major.insertion: Lateral lip of bicipital groove (clavicular head: anterior lamina; sternal head: posterior lamina)
pectoralis-major.action: Clavicular head: horizontal adduction, flexion, internal rotation; Sternal head: adduction, horizontal adduction, extension from flexed position, internal rotation
pectoralis-major.innervation: Clavicular head: lateral pectoral nerve (C5-C7); Sternal head: medial and lateral pectoral nerves (C6-T1)
pectoralis-major.blood_supply: Thoracoacromial artery, lateral thoracic artery, internal thoracic artery

pectoralis-minor.name: Pectoralis Minor
pectoralis-minor.description: Pectoralis Minor (العضلة الصدرية الصغرى) - Functional anatomical muscle.
pectoralis-minor.origin: Anterior surfaces of 3rd to 5th ribs near costal cartilages
pectoralis-minor.insertion: Coracoid process of scapula (medial border and upper surface)
pectoralis-minor.action: Scapular depression, protraction, and downward rotation; accessory inspiration

subclavius.name: Subclavius
subclavius.description: Subclavius (العضلة تحت الترقوة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
subclavius.origin: Junction of 1st rib and its costal cartilage
subclavius.insertion: Subclavian groove on inferior surface of middle third of clavicle
subclavius.action: Depresses and stabilizes clavicle in sternoclavicular joint

serratus-anterior.name: Serratus Anterior
serratus-anterior.description: Serratus Anterior (العضلة المنشارية الأمامية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
serratus-anterior.insertion: Medial border of scapula (upper part: superior angle; middle part: medial border; lower part: inferior angle)
serratus-anterior.action: Scapular protraction, upward rotation, posterior tilt, external rotation; stabilizes medial border and prevents winging
serratus-anterior.innervation: Long thoracic nerve (C5-C7; upper part mainly C5, middle and lower parts C6-C7)

latissimus-dorsi.name: Latissimus Dorsi
latissimus-dorsi.description: Latissimus Dorsi (العضلة العريضة الظهرية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
latissimus-dorsi.origin: Spinous processes T7-L5, posterior iliac crest, thoracolumbar fascia, inferior angle of scapula
latissimus-dorsi.insertion: Floor of bicipital groove of humerus
latissimus-dorsi.action: Extension, adduction, internal rotation; depressor (particularly during abduction)

teres-major.name: Teres Major
teres-major.description: Teres Major (العضلة المدورة الكبيرة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
teres-major.origin: Inferior angle and lower lateral border of scapula
teres-major.insertion: Medial lip of intertubercular groove of humerus
teres-major.action: Internal rotation, adduction, extension of the shoulder

coracobrachialis.name: Coracobrachialis
coracobrachialis.description: Coracobrachialis (العضلة الغرابية العضدية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
coracobrachialis.origin: Apex of coracoid process of scapula
coracobrachialis.blood_supply: Anterior circumflex humeral artery, brachial branches

biceps-brachii-long-head.name: Biceps Brachii Long Head
biceps-brachii-long-head.description: Biceps Brachii Long Head (عضلة البايسبس - الرأس الطويل) - Functional anatomical muscle.
biceps-brachii-long-head.origin: Supraglenoid tubercle of scapula and superior glenoid labrum
biceps-brachii-long-head.action: Forearm supination, elbow flexion, glenohumeral humeral head depression

biceps-brachii-short-head.name: Biceps Brachii Short Head
biceps-brachii-short-head.description: Biceps Brachii Short Head (عضلة البايسبس - الرأس القصير) - Functional anatomical muscle.
biceps-brachii-short-head.action: Forearm supination, elbow flexion, shoulder flexion

brachialis.name: Brachialis
brachialis.origin: Anterior surface of distal half of humerus
brachialis.insertion: Superficial head: ulnar tuberosity via thick tendon; Deep head: coronoid process via aponeurosis
brachialis.action: Elbow flexion (primary pure flexor, unaffected by forearm position)
brachialis.innervation: Musculocutaneous nerve (C5-C6) to superficial head; radial nerve contribution to deep head (83.33% of cases)

brachioradialis.name: Brachioradialis
brachioradialis.description: Brachioradialis (العضلة العضدية الكعبرية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
brachioradialis.origin: Proximal two-thirds of lateral supracondylar ridge of humerus
brachioradialis.insertion: Lateral aspect of distal radius (styloid process)
brachioradialis.action: Elbow flexion (most effective in neutral forearm), assists pronation from supinated and supination from pronated position
brachioradialis.blood_supply: Radial recurrent artery, radial artery branches

triceps-long-head.name: Triceps Long Head
triceps-long-head.description: Triceps Long Head (عضلة الترايسبس - الرأس الطويل) - Functional anatomical muscle.

triceps-lateral-head.name: Triceps Lateral Head
triceps-lateral-head.description: Triceps Lateral Head (عضلة الترايسبس - الرأس الوحشي) - Functional anatomical muscle.
triceps-lateral-head.origin: Posterior humerus superior and lateral to radial groove

triceps-medial-head.name: Triceps Medial Head
triceps-medial-head.description: Triceps Medial Head (عضلة الترايسبس - الرأس الإنسي) - Functional anatomical muscle.
triceps-medial-head.origin: Posterior humerus inferior and medial to radial groove
triceps-medial-head.action: Elbow extension at all joint angles
triceps-medial-head.blood_supply: Profunda brachii artery, superior ulnar collateral artery

anconeus.name: Anconeus
anconeus.action: Elbow extension assist, dynamic stabilization of ulnohumeral joint
anconeus.innervation: Radial nerve (triceps-anconeus branch); double innervation from posterior interosseous nerve branch in 70.4%
anconeus.blood_supply: Interosseous recurrent artery, middle collateral artery

pronator-teres.name: Pronator Teres
pronator-teres.description: Pronator Teres (العضلة الكابة المدورة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
pronator-teres.origin: Medial epicondyle of humerus (humeral head), coronoid process of ulna (ulnar head)
pronator-teres.insertion: Middle of lateral surface of radius
pronator-teres.blood_supply: Ulnar artery, anterior ulnar recurrent artery

pronator-quadratus.name: Pronator Quadratus
pronator-quadratus.description: Pronator Quadratus (العضلة الكابة المربعة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
pronator-quadratus.innervation: Anterior interosseous nerve (branch of median nerve, C7-C8)

supinator.name: Supinator
supinator.origin: Lateral epicondyle of humerus, supinator crest of ulna
supinator.innervation: Deep branch of radial nerve (C5, C6)

flexor-carpi-radialis.name: Flexor Carpi Radialis
flexor-carpi-radialis.description: Flexor Carpi Radialis (العضلة قابضة الرسغ الكعبرية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
flexor-carpi-radialis.origin: Medial epicondyle of humerus (common flexor origin)

flexor-carpi-ulnaris.name: Flexor Carpi Ulnaris
flexor-carpi-ulnaris.description: Flexor Carpi Ulnaris (العضلة قابضة الرسغ الزندية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
flexor-carpi-ulnaris.origin: Medial epicondyle (humeral head), olecranon and posterior ulna (ulnar head)
flexor-carpi-ulnaris.insertion: Pisiform, hook of hamate, base of 5th metacarpal

palmaris-longus.name: Palmaris Longus
palmaris-longus.description: Palmaris Longus (العضلة الراحية الطويلة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
palmaris-longus.origin: Medial epicondyle via anterior common tendon
palmaris-longus.action: Weak wrist flexion, tenses palmar aponeurosis
palmaris-longus.blood_supply: Branches from median nerve artery and ulnar artery

extensor-carpi-radialis-longus.name: Extensor Carpi Radialis Longus
extensor-carpi-radialis-longus.description: Extensor Carpi Radialis Longus (العضلة باسطة الرسغ الكعبرية الطويلة) - Functional anatomical muscle.

extensor-carpi-radialis-brevis.name: Extensor Carpi Radialis Brevis
extensor-carpi-radialis-brevis.description: Extensor Carpi Radialis Brevis (العضلة باسطة الرسغ الكعبرية القصيرة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
extensor-carpi-radialis-brevis.origin: Lateral epicondyle via long, wide tendinous origin on anterior slope

extensor-carpi-ulnaris.name: Extensor Carpi Ulnaris
extensor-carpi-ulnaris.description: Extensor Carpi Ulnaris (العضلة باسطة الرسغ الزندية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
extensor-carpi-ulnaris.origin: Lateral epicondyle and posterior ulnar border

extensor-digitorum.name: Extensor Digitorum
extensor-digitorum.description: Extensor Digitorum (العضلة باسطة الأصابع) - Functional anatomical muscle.
extensor-digitorum.origin: Lateral epicondyle of humerus (common extensor origin)
extensor-digitorum.action: Extension of MCP joints of fingers 2-5; assists wrist extension

rectus-abdominis.name: Rectus Abdominis
rectus-abdominis.description: Rectus Abdominis (العضلة البطنية المستقيمة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
rectus-abdominis.insertion: Costal cartilages of ribs 5-7, xiphoid process
rectus-abdominis.action: Trunk flexion, posterior pelvic tilt, compression of abdominal contents
rectus-abdominis.innervation: Thoracolumbar nerves (T6-L1), with a constant branch from L1; umbilicus always innervated by T10
rectus-abdominis.blood_supply: Superior epigastric artery, inferior epigastric artery, lower posterior intercostal arteries

external-oblique.name: External Oblique
external-oblique.description: External Oblique (العضلة المائلة الخارجية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
external-oblique.insertion: Linea alba, pubic tubercle, anterior half of iliac crest
external-oblique.action: Contralateral trunk rotation, ipsilateral lateral flexion, trunk flexion, core stabilization
external-oblique.blood_supply: Lower posterior intercostal arteries, subcostal artery, deep circumflex iliac artery

internal-oblique.name: Internal Oblique
internal-oblique.description: Internal Oblique (العضلة المائلة الداخلية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
internal-oblique.origin: Thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest, lateral two-thirds of inguinal ligament
internal-oblique.insertion: Lower ribs (10-12), linea alba, pubic crest
internal-oblique.action: Ipsilateral trunk rotation, lateral flexion, trunk flexion; highest activity during IAP generation tasks
internal-oblique.innervation: Thoracolumbar nerves (T6-L1), with 10th intercostal nerve providing a median of 9 branches
internal-oblique.blood_supply: Lower posterior intercostal arteries, deep circumflex iliac artery, deep inferior epigastric artery

transverse-abdominis.name: Transverse Abdominis
transverse-abdominis.description: Transverse Abdominis (العضلة البطنية المستعرضة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
transverse-abdominis.origin: Costal cartilages 7-12, thoracolumbar fascia, iliac crest, inguinal ligament
transverse-abdominis.insertion: Linea alba, pubic crest, pecten pubis via conjoint tendon
transverse-abdominis.action: Deep core stabilization, intra-abdominal pressure generation
transverse-abdominis.blood_supply: Deep circumflex iliac artery, inferior epigastric artery

quadratus-lumborum.name: Quadratus Lumborum
quadratus-lumborum.description: Quadratus Lumborum (العضلة المربعة القطنية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
quadratus-lumborum.action: Lateral flexion, 12th rib stabilization during inspiration; modest direct action on lumbar spine (<10% of extensor/lateral bending moments)
quadratus-lumborum.innervation: Ventral rami of T12-L4, with motor neurons in both ventromedial and lateromedial nuclei
quadratus-lumborum.blood_supply: Lumbar arteries, subcostal artery, iliolumbar artery

multifidus.name: Multifidus
multifidus.description: Multifidus (العضلة المتعددة الفصوص) - Functional anatomical muscle.
multifidus.origin: Posterior sacrum, superior iliac spine, mammillary processes of lumbar vertebrae, lateral sacral crest, thoracolumbar fascia (pennate bundle)
multifidus.insertion: Spinous processes of lumbar vertebrae, typically 2-4 levels above
multifidus.action: Segmental stabilization of the lumbar spine, extension, rotation control
multifidus.innervation: Medial branches of lumbar dorsal rami (L1-L5); each medial branch innervates only fascicles arising from the spinous process with the same segmental number
multifidus.blood_supply: Lumbar arteries (segmental branches from abdominal aorta)

iliocostalis.name: Iliocostalis
iliocostalis.description: Iliocostalis (العضلة الحرقفية الضلعية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
iliocostalis.origin: Thoracolumbar aponeurosis, sacrum, posterior iliac crest, angles of lower ribs
iliocostalis.insertion: Angles of ribs 1-12, transverse processes of cervical vertebrae C4-C6
iliocostalis.action: Spinal extension, lateral flexion of vertebral column

longissimus.name: Longissimus
longissimus.description: Longissimus (العضلة الطولى الظهرية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
longissimus.origin: Thoracolumbar aponeurosis, transverse processes of lumbar/thoracic vertebrae
longissimus.insertion: Transverse processes of thoracic and cervical vertebrae, mastoid process
longissimus.action: Spinal extension, lateral flexion, ipsilateral head rotation

spinalis.name: Spinalis
spinalis.origin: Spinous processes of upper lumbar and lower thoracic vertebrae
spinalis.insertion: Spinous processes of upper thoracic and cervical vertebrae

rotatores.name: Rotatores
rotatores.description: Rotatores (العضلات المدوّرة للعمود الفقري) - Functional anatomical muscle.
rotatores.insertion: Lamina and spinous process of vertebra directly above (brevis) or 2 above (longus)

interspinales.name: Interspinales
interspinales.description: Interspinales (العضلات بين الشوكية) - Functional anatomical muscle.

intertransversarii.name: Intertransversarii
intertransversarii.description: Intertransversarii (العضلات بين المستعرضة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
intertransversarii.action: Lateral flexion and motion segment stabilization
intertransversarii.innervation: Anterior and posterior rami of spinal nerves

diaphragm.name: Diaphragm
diaphragm.description: Diaphragm (عضلة الحجاب الحاجز) - Functional anatomical muscle.
diaphragm.origin: Xiphoid process, costal cartilages of ribs 7-12, lumbar vertebrae (crura attach to L1-L3)
diaphragm.action: Respiration (primary), increases intra-abdominal pressure, contributes to spinal stabilization by increasing intervertebral stiffness
diaphragm.blood_supply: Phrenic arteries, musculophrenic arteries, lower posterior intercostal arteries

levator-ani.name: Levator Ani
levator-ani.description: Levator Ani (العضلة الرافعة للشرج) - Functional anatomical muscle.
levator-ani.origin: Body of pubis, tendinous arch of obturator fascia, ischial spine
levator-ani.action: Supports pelvic floor viscera, resists intra-abdominal pressure
levator-ani.innervation: Nerve to levator ani (S4), pudendal nerve (S2-S4)
levator-ani.blood_supply: Inferior gluteal and internal pudendal arteries

coccygeus.name: Coccygeus
coccygeus.insertion: Lateral margins of coccyx and sacrum
coccygeus.innervation: Anterior rami of S4-S5 spinal nerves

trapezius-upper.name: Trapezius Upper
trapezius-upper.description: Trapezius Upper (العضلة الشبه منحرفة - العلوي) - Functional anatomical muscle.
trapezius-upper.origin: External occipital protuberance, medial superior nuchal line, ligamentum nuchae, C7 spinous process
trapezius-upper.action: Scapular elevation, upward rotation; draws scapula backward; raises scapula by rotating clavicle
trapezius-upper.innervation: Spinal accessory nerve (CN XI), with proprioceptive and motor contributions from C3-C4

gluteus-maximus.name: Gluteus Maximus
gluteus-maximus.description: Gluteus Maximus (العضلة الألية الكبرى) - Functional anatomical muscle.
gluteus-maximus.origin: Posterior gluteal line of ilium, dorsal surface of sacrum and coccyx, sacrotuberous ligament
gluteus-maximus.insertion: Superior three-fourths: gluteal tuberosity of femur via plate-like distal tendon, with partial adhesions to iliotibial tract; inferior portion: lateral femoral intermuscular septum complex
gluteus-maximus.action: Hip extension, external rotation; upper fibers assist abduction, lower fibers assist adduction

gluteus-medius.name: Gluteus Medius
gluteus-medius.description: Gluteus Medius (العضلة الألية المتوسطة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
gluteus-medius.origin: Gluteal fossa (between anterior and posterior gluteal lines), gluteal aponeurosis, posteroinferior edge of iliac crest
gluteus-medius.insertion: Lateral and superoposterior facets of greater trochanter via lateral and posterior tendon parts
gluteus-medius.action: Anterior fibers: abduction and internal rotation; middle fibers: abduction; posterior fibers: abduction and external rotation; primary hip stabilizer during initial gait phase and pelvic rotation
gluteus-medius.innervation: Superior gluteal nerve (L4-S1) with 3-4 branches supplying different muscle regions

gluteus-minimus.name: Gluteus Minimus
gluteus-minimus.description: Gluteus Minimus (العضلة الألية الصغرى) - Functional anatomical muscle.
gluteus-minimus.origin: Gluteal fossa (between anterior and inferior gluteal lines)
gluteus-minimus.insertion: Anterior facet of greater trochanter and hip joint capsule
gluteus-minimus.action: Hip abduction, internal rotation; primary hip stabilizer during mid- and late gait cycle
gluteus-minimus.innervation: Superior gluteal nerve (L4-S1) with distinct secondary nerve branches entering four muscle regions

tensor-fasciae-latae.name: Tensor Fasciae Latae
tensor-fasciae-latae.description: Tensor Fasciae Latae (العضلة موترة اللفافة العريضة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
tensor-fasciae-latae.origin: Anterior superior iliac spine (ASIS) and outer lip of iliac crest
tensor-fasciae-latae.action: Hip flexion, abduction, internal rotation; tenses the fascia lata
tensor-fasciae-latae.blood_supply: Ascending branch of lateral circumflex femoral artery

piriformis.name: Piriformis
piriformis.action: External rotation, abduction (particularly with hip in slight extension); hip stabilization

obturator-internus.name: Obturator Internus
obturator-internus.description: Obturator Internus (العضلة السدادية الداخلية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
obturator-internus.origin: Inner surface of obturator membrane and surrounding pelvic bone
obturator-internus.insertion: Medial surface of greater trochanter (forms continuum with gemelli)

obturator-externus.name: Obturator Externus
obturator-externus.description: Obturator Externus (العضلة السدادية الخارجية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
obturator-externus.origin: Outer surface of obturator membrane and pubic ramus
obturator-externus.blood_supply: Obturator artery, medial circumflex femoral artery

gemellus-superior.name: Gemellus Superior
gemellus-superior.description: Gemellus Superior (العضلة التوأمية العلوية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
gemellus-superior.insertion: Medial surface of greater trochanter of femur with obturator internus
gemellus-superior.action: Hip external rotation in extension, hip abduction in flexion

gemellus-inferior.name: Gemellus Inferior
gemellus-inferior.description: Gemellus Inferior (العضلة التوأمية السفلية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
gemellus-inferior.insertion: Medial surface of greater trochanter of femur with obturator internus
gemellus-inferior.action: Hip external rotation in extension, hip abduction in flexion

quadratus-femoris.name: Quadratus Femoris
quadratus-femoris.description: Quadratus Femoris (العضلة المربعة الفخذية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
quadratus-femoris.insertion: Intertrochanteric crest and quadrate tubercle of femur
quadratus-femoris.blood_supply: Inferior gluteal artery, medial circumflex femoral artery

psoas-major.name: Psoas Major
psoas-major.description: Psoas Major (العضلة القطنية الكبرى) - Functional anatomical muscle.
psoas-major.origin: Transverse processes L1-L5, vertebral bodies T12-L5
psoas-major.insertion: Lesser trochanter of femur via conjoint iliopsoas tendon
psoas-major.action: Primary hip flexor, trunk flexion from supine, lumbar stabilizer
psoas-major.innervation: Anterior rami of lumbar spinal nerves L1-L3

psoas-minor.name: Psoas Minor
psoas-minor.description: Psoas Minor (العضلة القطنية الصغرى) - Functional anatomical muscle.
psoas-minor.origin: Vertebral bodies T12 and L1 and intervertebral disc
psoas-minor.insertion: Pectineal line of pubis, iliopubic eminence
psoas-minor.action: Weak trunk flexor, tenses iliac fascia
psoas-minor.innervation: Anterior ramus of L1 spinal nerve

iliacus.name: Iliacus
iliacus.origin: Superior two-thirds of iliac fossa, internal lip of iliac crest, ala of sacrum
iliacus.insertion: Lesser trochanter of femur with psoas major tendon
iliacus.action: Hip flexion and anterior pelvic tilt
iliacus.blood_supply: Iliolumbar artery, medial circumflex femoral artery

pectineus.name: Pectineus
pectineus.insertion: Pectineal line of femur (posterior to lesser trochanter)
pectineus.action: Hip flexion, adduction; hip stabilizer during rotational movements
pectineus.innervation: Femoral nerve (L2-L3), may receive accessory innervation from obturator nerve
pectineus.blood_supply: Medial circumflex femoral artery, obturator artery

adductor-longus.name: Adductor Longus
adductor-longus.description: Adductor Longus (العضلة المقربة الطويلة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
adductor-longus.blood_supply: Medial circumflex femoral artery, obturator artery

adductor-brevis.name: Adductor Brevis
adductor-brevis.description: Adductor Brevis (العضلة المقربة القصيرة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
adductor-brevis.origin: Anteroinferior aspect of pubic body and inferior pubic ramus
adductor-brevis.insertion: Proximal linea aspera and pectineal line
adductor-brevis.blood_supply: Medial circumflex femoral artery, obturator artery

adductor-magnus.name: Adductor Magnus
adductor-magnus.description: Adductor Magnus (العضلة المقربة الكبيرة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
adductor-magnus.origin: Adductor portion: inferior pubic ramus and ischial ramus; Hamstring portion: ischial tuberosity
adductor-magnus.insertion: Adductor portion: linea aspera; Hamstring portion: adductor tubercle of femur
adductor-magnus.action: Adduction; adductor portion also flexes and internally rotates; hamstring portion extends and externally rotates
adductor-magnus.innervation: Dual innervation: adductor portion receives both posterior branch of obturator nerve (L2-L4) and tibial portion of sciatic nerve (L4-S1) in >90% of cases; hamstring portion receives tibial nerve
adductor-magnus.blood_supply: Medial circumflex femoral artery, perforating branches of profunda femoris

gracilis.name: Gracilis
gracilis.origin: Body and inferior ramus of pubis
gracilis.insertion: Medial surface of proximal tibia (pes anserinus)
gracilis.action: Hip adduction, knee flexion, knee internal rotation
gracilis.blood_supply: Main pedicle from medial femoral circumflex or profunda femoris (~10 cm from origin); 1-3 distal branches from superficial femoral artery

sartorius.name: Sartorius
sartorius.insertion: Medial surface of proximal tibia (pes anserinus)
sartorius.action: Hip flexion, hip external rotation, hip abduction; knee flexion
sartorius.blood_supply: Multiple vascular pedicles (average 6-7) from femoral artery

rectus-femoris.name: Rectus Femoris
rectus-femoris.description: Rectus Femoris (العضلة الفخذية المستقيمة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
rectus-femoris.origin: Anterior inferior iliac spine (straight head) and ilium above acetabulum (reflected head)
rectus-femoris.insertion: Patella via quadriceps tendon, then tibial tuberosity via patellar ligament

vastus-lateralis.name: Vastus Lateralis
vastus-lateralis.description: Vastus Lateralis (العضلة المتسعة الوحشية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
vastus-lateralis.origin: Lateral lip of linea aspera, greater trochanter, intertrochanteric line
vastus-lateralis.insertion: Patella (lateral aspect) via quadriceps tendon; consists of superficial, intermediate, and deep layers
vastus-lateralis.action: Knee extension; acts as general joint stabilizer with activation independent of moment direction

vastus-medialis-oblique-vmo.name: Vastus Medialis Oblique (VMO)
vastus-medialis-oblique-vmo.description: Vastus Medialis Oblique (VMO) (العضلة المتسعة الإنسية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
vastus-medialis-oblique-vmo.origin: Distal medial lip of linea aspera and medial supracondylar line of femur
vastus-medialis-oblique-vmo.insertion: Medial border of patella and medial patellar retinaculum
vastus-medialis-oblique-vmo.action: Terminal knee extension, medial patellar stabilization

vastus-intermedius.name: Vastus Intermedius
vastus-intermedius.description: Vastus Intermedius (العضلة المتسعة المتوسطة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
vastus-intermedius.origin: Anterior and lateral surface of femoral shaft
vastus-intermedius.insertion: Patella (deep layer) via quadriceps tendon; forms complex multi-layered structure with VM
vastus-intermedius.innervation: Femoral nerve (L2-L4), with medial portions sharing innervation with VM

biceps-femoris-long-head.name: Biceps Femoris Long Head
biceps-femoris-long-head.description: Biceps Femoris Long Head (عضلة الفخذ الخلفية - الرأس الطويل) - Functional anatomical muscle.
biceps-femoris-long-head.insertion: Head of fibula, lateral tibial condyle
biceps-femoris-long-head.action: Knee flexion, hip extension, knee external rotation
biceps-femoris-long-head.innervation: Tibial division of sciatic nerve (L5-S2); typically 1-2 branches
biceps-femoris-long-head.blood_supply: Perforating branches of profunda femoris artery

biceps-femoris-short-head.name: Biceps Femoris Short Head
biceps-femoris-short-head.description: Biceps Femoris Short Head (عضلة الفخذ الخلفية - الرأس القصير) - Functional anatomical muscle.
biceps-femoris-short-head.origin: Lateral lip of linea aspera, lateral supracondylar line
biceps-femoris-short-head.insertion: Head of fibula (joins long head tendon)
biceps-femoris-short-head.innervation: Common fibular (peroneal) division of sciatic nerve (L5-S2); single branch
biceps-femoris-short-head.blood_supply: Perforating branches of profunda femoris artery

semitendinosus.name: Semitendinosus
semitendinosus.description: Semitendinosus (العضلة نصف الوترية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
semitendinosus.origin: Ischial tuberosity (conjoint tendon with biceps femoris long head)
semitendinosus.insertion: Medial surface of proximal tibia (pes anserinus)
semitendinosus.action: Knee flexion, hip extension, knee internal rotation
semitendinosus.innervation: Tibial division of sciatic nerve (L5-S2); always 2 branches (superior and inferior)
semitendinosus.blood_supply: Perforating branches of profunda femoris artery, superficial femoral artery branches

semimembranosus.name: Semimembranosus
semimembranosus.description: Semimembranosus (العضلة نصف الغشائية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
semimembranosus.insertion: Posterior medial tibial condyle with multiple expansions
semimembranosus.action: Knee flexion, hip extension, knee internal rotation
semimembranosus.innervation: Tibial division of sciatic nerve (L5-S2); usually single branch
semimembranosus.blood_supply: Perforating branches of profunda femoris artery

popliteus.name: Popliteus
popliteus.action: Knee internal rotation, 'unlocking' the knee from full extension, posterolateral stabilization
popliteus.innervation: Tibial nerve (L4-S1); 90% tibial nerve alone, 10% tibial and sciatic
popliteus.blood_supply: Inferior medial genicular artery (90%), posterior tibial artery (65%)

plantaris.name: Plantaris
plantaris.origin: Lateral supracondylar line of femur, oblique popliteal ligament
plantaris.action: Weak knee flexion, weak ankle plantarflexion

articularis-genus.name: Articularis Genus
articularis-genus.description: Articularis Genus (العضلة المفصلية للركبة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
articularis-genus.origin: Anterior surface of distal femur below vastus intermedius
articularis-genus.action: Retracts suprapatellar bursa during knee extension to prevent impingement

pectineus-minor.name: Pectineus Minor
pectineus-minor.description: Pectineus Minor (العضلة العانية الفرعية) - Functional anatomical muscle.

tibialis-anterior.name: Tibialis Anterior
tibialis-anterior.description: Tibialis Anterior (العضلة القصبية الأمامية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
tibialis-anterior.origin: Lateral tibial condyle, upper two-thirds of lateral tibial surface, interosseous membrane
tibialis-anterior.insertion: Medial cuneiform and base of 1st metatarsal

tibialis-posterior.name: Tibialis Posterior
tibialis-posterior.description: Tibialis Posterior (العضلة القصبية الخلفية) - Functional anatomical muscle.
tibialis-posterior.origin: Posterior tibia, fibula, and interosseous membrane
tibialis-posterior.insertion: Navicular tuberosity and plantar surfaces of cuneiforms and metatarsals 2-4
tibialis-posterior.action: Foot inversion, assists plantarflexion, supports medial longitudinal arch

gastrocnemius-lateral-head.name: Gastrocnemius Lateral Head
gastrocnemius-lateral-head.description: Gastrocnemius Lateral Head (عضلة السمانة - الرأس الوحشي) - Functional anatomical muscle.
gastrocnemius-lateral-head.origin: Lateral condyle and posterolateral surface of femur
gastrocnemius-lateral-head.insertion: Posterior surface of calcaneus via Achilles tendon
gastrocnemius-lateral-head.action: Ankle plantarflexion and knee flexion assistance

gastrocnemius-medial-head.name: Gastrocnemius Medial Head
gastrocnemius-medial-head.description: Gastrocnemius Medial Head (عضلة السمانة - الرأس الإنسي) - Functional anatomical muscle.
gastrocnemius-medial-head.origin: Popliteal surface of femur superior to medial condyle
gastrocnemius-medial-head.insertion: Posterior surface of calcaneus via Achilles tendon

soleus.name: Soleus
soleus.origin: Posterior surface of fibular head, proximal tibia (soleal line)
soleus.action: Ankle plantarflexion (especially during slow/postural activities); selectively activated with knee extension
soleus.blood_supply: Posterior tibial artery, peroneal artery (dual supply)

fibularis-peroneus-longus.name: Fibularis (Peroneus) Longus
fibularis-peroneus-longus.description: Fibularis (Peroneus) Longus (العضلة الشظوية الطويلة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
fibularis-peroneus-longus.origin: Head and upper two-thirds of lateral fibula
fibularis-peroneus-longus.insertion: Medial cuneiform and base of 1st metatarsal
fibularis-peroneus-longus.action: Foot eversion, ankle plantarflexion, supports transverse arch

fibularis-peroneus-brevis.name: Fibularis (Peroneus) Brevis
fibularis-peroneus-brevis.description: Fibularis (Peroneus) Brevis (العضلة الشظوية القصيرة) - Functional anatomical muscle.

fibularis-peroneus-tertius.name: Fibularis (Peroneus) Tertius
fibularis-peroneus-tertius.description: Fibularis (Peroneus) Tertius (العضلة الشظوية الثالثة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
fibularis-peroneus-tertius.origin: Distal third of anterior fibula and interosseous membrane
fibularis-peroneus-tertius.insertion: Dorsal surface of base of 5th metatarsal

extensor-hallucis-longus.name: Extensor Hallucis Longus
extensor-hallucis-longus.description: Extensor Hallucis Longus (العضلة باسطة إبهام القدم الطويلة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
extensor-hallucis-longus.action: Great toe extension, assists ankle dorsiflexion

extensor-digitorum-longus.name: Extensor Digitorum Longus
extensor-digitorum-longus.description: Extensor Digitorum Longus (العضلة باسطة أصابع القدم الطويلة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
extensor-digitorum-longus.origin: Lateral tibial condyle, fibula, interosseous membrane
extensor-digitorum-longus.insertion: Middle and distal phalanges of toes 2-5

flexor-hallucis-longus.name: Flexor Hallucis Longus
flexor-hallucis-longus.description: Flexor Hallucis Longus (العضلة قابضة إبهام القدم الطويلة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
flexor-hallucis-longus.action: Great toe flexion (IP), assists ankle plantarflexion

flexor-digitorum-longus.name: Flexor Digitorum Longus
flexor-digitorum-longus.description: Flexor Digitorum Longus (العضلة قابضة أصابع القدم الطويلة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
flexor-digitorum-longus.action: Toe flexion (DIP toes 2-5), assists ankle plantarflexion

extensor-digitorum-brevis.name: Extensor Digitorum Brevis
extensor-digitorum-brevis.description: Extensor Digitorum Brevis (العضلة باسطة أصابع القدم القصيرة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
extensor-digitorum-brevis.insertion: Bases of middle and distal phalanges of toes 2-4
extensor-digitorum-brevis.action: Extends toes 2-4 at MTP and IP joints

flexor-digitorum-brevis.name: Flexor Digitorum Brevis
flexor-digitorum-brevis.description: Flexor Digitorum Brevis (العضلة قابضة أصابع القدم القصيرة) - Functional anatomical muscle.
flexor-digitorum-brevis.origin: Medial process of calcaneal tuberosity and plantar aponeurosis
flexor-digitorum-brevis.insertion: Middle phalanges of lateral four toes (digits 2-5)
flexor-digitorum-brevis.action: Flexion of PIP joints of toes 2-5, longitudinal arch support

abductor-hallucis.name: Abductor Hallucis
abductor-hallucis.description: Abductor Hallucis (العضلة مبعّدة إبهام القدم) - Functional anatomical muscle.
abductor-hallucis.origin: Medial process of calcaneal tuberosity and flexor retinaculum
abductor-hallucis.insertion: Medial side of base of proximal phalanx of great toe
abductor-hallucis.action: Abduction and flexion of great toe, supports medial longitudinal arch

adductor-hallucis.name: Adductor Hallucis
adductor-hallucis.description: Adductor Hallucis (العضلة مقربة إبهام القدم) - Functional anatomical muscle.
adductor-hallucis.origin: Oblique head: bases of metatarsals 2-4; Transverse head: plantar MTP ligaments 3-5
adductor-hallucis.insertion: Lateral side of base of proximal phalanx of great toe
adductor-hallucis.action: Adduction of great toe, supports transverse arch
adductor-hallucis.innervation: Deep branch of lateral plantar nerve (S2, S3)
